_source.title: 保存设计规则配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 只有自定义配置可以覆盖保存，系统配置不允许修改和覆盖
_source.params.allowOverwrite: 是否允许覆写同名设计规则配置，`false` 则将在遇到同名设计规则配置时返回 `false`，请注意可能的数据丢失风险

title: Save Design rule configuration
remarks.text.0: Only custom configurations can be overwritten and saved. System configurations cannot be modified or overwritten
params.allowOverwrite: Whether to allow overwriting a design rule configuration with the same name. If `false`, `false` will be returned when a configuration with the same name is encountered. Please note the possible risk of data loss
